messages:
leo: starting rollout for model xformer-3b-v2-quant4x on hosted. staging at 1% traffic. will monitor quality and latency fences. tagging @ops and @qa :eyes:

maya: quick summary of smoke evals: small eval harness vs 5k prompts — mean embedding sim 0.982 vs baseline 0.985 (-0.3%), stop rate +0.4pp, p99 latency +12ms. nothing huge but watch hallucination/open-ended factuality metric (we used a synthetic set).

sam: propose a tiered traffic fence + auto-fallback. if embedding_cos_sim drops >1% relative, or hallucination_rate +2pp, trigger rollback to model v2.2 within 5m. if p99 latency >30% over baseline, divert traffic to dedicated pool. also set min-samples per stage.

anna: add signal smoothing for noisy metrics. use rolling 15m windows and min sample size 500 requests per step. require violation in 2 out of 3 consecutive windows before rollback (hysteresis).

leo: here's rollout config I'll push to infra:
```
rollout:
  stages: [1, 5, 25, 100]
  step_duration: "60m"
  min_samples_per_stage: 500
  metrics:
    - name: embedding_cos_sim
      threshold: -0.01    # relative drop (1%)
    - name: hallucination_rate
      threshold: +0.02    # absolute increase in pp (2 percentage points)
    - name: p99_latency
      threshold: +0.30    # 30% degrade over baseline
  smoothing: {window: "15m", required_violations: 2}
  auto_fallback: true
  fallback_target: "v2.2"
```

ops-bot: noted. will attach circuit-breaker. auto rollback will create a revert PR and run smoke tests. ops will also create an incident if error_rate > 0.5%.

maya: small ask: record per-route token counts and cost delta. quant4x could shift soft-decode distribution; add avg_output_entropy metric to catch collapsed outputs.

sam: agreed. add 'avg_output_entropy' with threshold drop >5% (relative). also add 'user-visible-broke' synthetic probes.

anna: we'll gate promotion to 100% until metrics stable for 6h across all regions and no region-specific regressions. also require no increase in user-reported escapes in the first 24h.

leo: thanks. I'll deploy the config and start the 1% run at 1958730000 UTC. will post updates here. :thumbsup:

maya: :rocket:

ops-bot: rollout scheduled at 1958730000. monitoring hooks: datadog->#alerts, traces posted to console. fallback ready.
